name: Hill — Hunt Upper School

north_roof_repair.method: Extrapolate the nearest credible source roof plane into the low north patches. Those patches conflict with photographs of a continuous multi-storey building; this is a photo-informed correction, not new survey data.

window_reveal.construction: Panes sit in the outer masonry frame. Extra edge panes bridge one-cell diagonal gaps inside the reveal; nothing is attached outside the building.

uncertainties: Hunt's source Roofer RMSE is 1.550174 m, selected with insufficient coverage; small roof details are less reliable than Ryan or Athey.
Low north roof patches are explicitly corrected by nearest credible roof-plane extrapolation. Raw source geometry remains unchanged and correction counts are recorded.
Arcade/window/dormer rhythm and finished-floor heights are photo interpretations for the first native comparison, not certified architectural dimensions.
North stair-tower shapes, retaining-wall terraces, fine roof ornament and concealed facades require further photo comparison.

Warm red slopes use ordinary waxed cut-copper blocks, slabs and stairs as a visual approximation of the photographed roof, not a claim about its actual installed material. Green cornices use waxed oxidized copper. Brick is confined to photographed brick walls and brick paving.
Interior floor plates are unfurnished construction proxies.
This revision uses only original Minecraft textures. Terracotta dressed trim and mud-brick partial blocks approximate the warm masonry; colour is a visual interpretation, not an exact texture match.

evidence.supports: Exact parent identity, 75.353 by 26.319 m oriented envelope, taller end-wing ridges and lower connecting roof.
Stone round arcade, brick upper walls, red dormered roof, copper-green cornice and central ornamental bay.
North lower masonry storey, brick walls, stair towers, retaining-wall drop and distinct north-side window rhythms.
